title: Unex
wikitext:
Originally a CTF player from the famous dutch clan [[Veni Vidi Vici]], a team with which he won countless CTF tournaments both on and offline. Later went on to play TDM, at first with [[Veni Vidi Vici|VVV]] but after they went inactive with other clans such as [[Brutality]] and currently [[Tribe of Tjernobyl]]. Was also a succesful Quake 3 player both [[1on1]] and TDM with [[Firing Squad]].
